title: The Four-Column Sales Log For Your Side Hustle
hook_text: MOST SELLERS CANNOT SAY WHO OWES

beats.say: Most small sellers cannot say who still owes them money.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a weathered wooden desk under a single amber bulb, cold blue hour light cutting through blinds.

beats.say: Unpaid invoices bleed side hustles dry before they ever scale.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of heavy rain washing across dark asphalt under a sodium streetlamp.

beats.say: Where does that missing cash actually vanish to every single month?
beats.visual: Silhouette of a lone figure standing near the edge of a massive concrete bridge at dusk.

beats.say: Most people think memory is enough to track a growing side income.
beats.visual: Extreme wide view of an empty highway stretching into a dense gray fog.

beats.say: That memory fails the moment you cross ten clients a month.
beats.visual: Cold fluorescent light reflecting off wet steel beams inside an abandoned transit station.

beats.say: Step one. Open a blank sheet and name your first column date.
beats.visual: Close-up of a bare metal table illuminated by a harsh overhead workshop lamp.

beats.say: Step two. Add the customer name so you know exactly who bought.
beats.visual: High angle shot of dark ocean waves crashing against a jagged stone shoreline at night.

beats.say: Step three. Put the exact dollar amount in column three.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a rusted metal tower cutting into a cold twilight sky.

beats.say: Step four. Type paid or unpaid as the final column gate.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of heavy iron rivets on a dark industrial bridge under sodium light.

beats.say: That simple four-column log stops cash from walking out the back door.
beats.visual: Low angle view of a towering concrete overpass cutting through thick evening mist.

beats.say: An extra $1,000 a month from a side income invested at 8% for 10 years hits $182,946.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a dark mountain ridge line under a cold blue winter moon.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Single practical light casting a long shadow down an empty concrete corridor at night.

caption: Four columns fix a leaking side hustle. Follow for the money rules school never taught you. #sidehustle #moneytips #personalfinance #businessowner #wealthmindset
description: A simple four-column sales log stops side hustle money from going missing. Learn the exact columns to track date, customer, amount, and payment status.
